insights.one_liner: BlockTech is an Amsterdam algorithmic trading firm in crypto derivatives, with about 120 staff, IND sponsor status and very popular postings.

culture.text: About 120 people, founded in 2018 in Amsterdam; it trades crypto derivatives and spot markets 24/7 with automated systems.
Staff come from NUS, UvA, TU Delft, VU and NTU Singapore, mostly in computer science, maths and econometrics.
It describes a collaborative team of trading and tech enthusiasts where you will be challenged and stretched.
Its 2 open jobs here are an entry-level role and an internship, in data and software, in Amsterdam.

open.text: BlockTech B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.
Both current postings need no Dutch and one mentions visa or relocation, but they average about 200 LinkedIn applicants.
